exact_query_token_counts: pending; verify with the adopted encoder before each first benchmark forward, rejecting over200 rather than truncating
held_out_scope: question-information-need families held out from development retrieval comparison; source units and publishers may be shared
limitations: Assistant-authored and assistant-reviewed scoped pilot; no human or independent scientific validation.
Sixty dependent question rows represent thirty information-need families and eleven source units.
Three related source families: two CDC guidance groups and one UGA textbook; not representative of all basketball resources or approved drills.
Every supported question has a single relevant unit and single-unit sufficient set; multi-unit synthesis is not tested.
Ranking scores and evidence-set coverage do not evaluate generated answers or abstention accuracy.

metric_policy.complete_evidence_set_covered_at_5: Separate from ranking relevance: available only for supported questions with reviewed sufficient sets and a completed ranking; true if any full set is contained in top5.
metric_policy.empty_completed_ranking: A completed retrieval returning zero units: Recall and reciprocal rank are zero when R is nonempty.

final_category_consistency.positive_categories: supported with one or more nonempty sufficient evidence sets
final_category_consistency.unsupported_by_identified_corpus: partially_supported or unsupported, with no sufficient full-answer evidence set

metric_policy.final_judgment_requirement: Complete review of the identified corpus, relevance labels, required claims and sufficient evidence sets; IDs alone do not prove semantic review.
metric_policy.partial_or_unsupported_full_evidence_cov: Unavailable because no reviewed sufficient full-answer set exists; not automatically zero or perfect.
metric_policy.pending_failed_missing_outcomes: Unscored and unavailable; never silently dropped to select a method. Selection requires all30 development judgments and both routes'30 completed outcomes.
metric_policy.recall_at_5: For a final nonempty relevant-unit set R: |retrieved_top5 intersect R| / |R|.
metric_policy.reciprocal_rank_at_5: For a final nonempty R: reciprocal of the first relevant rank within top5; zero if there is no hit.
metric_policy.selection_denominator: All final development questions with nonempty relevant-unit sets, including unsupported-category questions with partial/topic relevance; identical query IDs for both routes.

support_statuses.partially_supported: Some required claims have support, but no reviewed set supports the full request.
support_statuses.pending: Support review is unfinished; no metric is assigned.
support_statuses.supported: At least one reviewed evidence set covers all required claims with the required context.
support_statuses.unsupported: No required claim is supported by the identified corpus; topically relevant units may still exist.

query_order: Filter saved question rows by split, retaining order and partition_ordinal1..30; the verified query-runtime IDs must match before encoding.
relevance_definition: Direct answer evidence, necessary qualification, or explicitly documented question-specific topical context. Broad basketball overlap is insufficient; relevance does not establish complete answer support.
